PLAY.NO_MANA: Not enough Mana to activate a Magic Factor.
PLAY.NO_CHANT: You haven't played a Chant card this turn.
BOOK_HINT: Right-click a tool, then left-click its targets. It activates when all targets are chosen. Right-click again or press Esc to cancel.

TIP.CHANT.title: Chant
TIP.CHANT.description: Choose an equipped factor. Consume the [gold]Mana[/gold] required from its pile to activate it. The [gold]Chant[/gold] card determines the factor's X.
TIP.LEGENDARY.title: Legendary Spell
TIP.LEGENDARY.description: Playable after you have played a [gold]Chant[/gold] card this turn.
TIP.DIVINITY.title: Mantra & Divinity
TIP.DIVINITY.description: Every 10 Mantra are consumed to enter [gold]Divinity[/gold] and gain 3 Energy. [gold]Divinity[/gold] triples attack damage until your next turn.
TIP.MANA_PAYMENT.title: Mana Payment
TIP.MANA_PAYMENT.description: Pay [gold]Mana[/gold] equal to the normal Energy cost, from Draw, Hand, then Discard. Insufficient [gold]Mana[/gold] prevents play. X-cost cards still consume Energy.
TIP.SEALED.title: Sealed
TIP.SEALED.description: Removed from the pile at combat start. Play 5 [gold]Chant[/gold] cards in one turn to release it into your Hand.
TIP.SECOND_DEFENSE.title: Defensive Follow-up
TIP.SECOND_DEFENSE.description: Costs 0 Energy and Exhausts. [gold]Chant[/gold] 1 and gain the same Block as the Defensive Magic that created it, retaining its upgrade.

PROP.CrystalBall: Swap the slots of two equipped factors.
PROP.MysteryBox: Gain two random factors (excluding puzzle factors) in your unequipped inventory.
PROP.MysticBox: Choose three unequipped factors and equip them in random slots. Return the previous factors to inventory.
PROP.SeinNote: Remove two unequipped factors or other tools. Heal 10 HP.
PROP.ShadowDragonHorn: Combat only. Remove two unequipped factors or other tools. Gain 2 Energy.
PROP.TransmutationCircle: Transform two factors into random factors of the same rarity (excluding puzzle factors), keeping their slots.
PROP.UnbelievableTool: Swap an equipped factor with an unequipped factor. Keep the previous factor in inventory.
PROP.UnbelievableToolBox: Remove two unequipped factors or other tools. Gain two Unbelievable Tools.
PROP_UNAVAILABLE: Unavailable: check target requirements and the current combat phase.
FACTOR_HINT: X is Chant intensity. Use tools to change equipped factors; each slot uses its own pile's Mana.
NO_PROPS: No tools yet. Choose Magic Shop at a camp to acquire two tools.
PROP_USED: Tool consumed. Factors and inventory updated.
PROP_CANCELLED: Cancelled or invalid targets. Tool not consumed. Follow the target requirements.
PROP_ERROR: An error occurred. Please check the game log.
SHOP_SELECT: Choose {Amount} tools. Confirm to spend this camp action, or cancel to return.
PROP_SELECT: Use {Prop}: choose {Amount} targets. Cancel without consuming the tool.
